If retest requested for other flows, remember: admin must select a station (data-testid='station-select-trigger') before /nobet; if no schedule exists click data-testid='generate-btn' (requires >=3 active personnel).
rca of the issue: Previously window.open() launched a top-level navigation which does not carry the axios Authorization/X-Istasyon-Id headers, so the FastAPI dependency responded 401. Fix replaces the anchor navigation with an authenticated axios GET (responseType:'blob'), converts the blob to an object URL, and programmatically triggers a hidden <a download> click. This preserves the JWT + station headers via the existing interceptor, and produces a real browser download event instead of a new tab. Retest confirms 200 responses and correct Content-Type / Content-Disposition for all five endpoints.
